paraphrase: Effacement should be practised thus: 'Others will be cruel, we shall not be cruel … others will kill, we shall abstain … others will be greedy, envious, deceitful, obstinate, of wrong view, we shall not' — forty-four such resolves, each also a path of turning the mind and of avoidance.
